		define_state = "moving"
	}

	{
		on_movement_start =
		{
	        IfState( moving, 0,
	        {
	            SetStateTo( moving, 1 );
				PlayAnimation( run );
	        } );
	    }
	
		on_movement_stop =
		{
	        IfState( moving, 1,
	        {
	            SetStateTo( moving, 0 );
				IfTownOrHideoutArea( { PlayAnimation( idle_town ); }, { PlayAnimation( idle_battle ); } );
	        } );
	    }
	}
	
	ObjectHiding
	{
		
	}
